description: Evidence manifest proving report generation was reconstructed from central DB and file-server artifact metadata without Excel as a source.
source_rules: source_snapshot must include central_db_migration_evidence_id, ingestion_batch_id, and measurement_result_count > 0
snapshot_sha256 must be a 64-character lowercase hex digest
generated_output_rules: sha256 must be a 64-character lowercase hex digest
artifact_rules: artifact_resolution must include required_count and resolved_count
unresolved required artifacts must have an approved classification, reviewed_by, and reason
resolved_count plus classified missing artifacts must cover required_count
any missing artifact requires acceptance_audit.status to be approved_with_findings
runner_notes: The validator checks captured metadata only. The companion CLI execute runner may read a central DB snapshot or connect to PostgreSQL with an explicit DSN, compose CentralDbReportSourceAdapter with the report generator, hash generated outputs, and write this manifest without using Excel as a report source.
